title: Turmeric Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Turmeric Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Turmeric nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen and potassium in luyang dilaw, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Turmeric nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your luyang dilaw (turmeric) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus, iron, magnesium, zinc, sulfur and manganese. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.alt: Nitrogen deficiency on a leaf, shown on another crop as a stand in for turmeric
heroImage.credit: Maja Dumat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus and magnesium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But iron, zinc, sulfur and manganese stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which turmeric nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a turmeric nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest turmeric nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in turmeric

Pale or yellow green leaves appear first on the older leaves. Reddish tints start at the leaf edges and spread toward the midrib. Leaves are small, growth slows markedly and rhizome yield drops. You see it most at this stage: from planting to about 4 months.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Worn out or sandy soils, heavy rain and too little fertilizer.
How to tell it apart
Magnesium deficiency yellows between the veins with an arrowhead at the leaf base. Leaf spot gives spots, not an even pale color. To be sure, check that the old leaves yellowed first. Soil test.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

Give 140 kg N per hectare as urea in five splits (at planting and 30, 60, 90 and 120 days after), with 60 kg P2O5 and 60 kg K2O. For quick help spray 2 percent DAP 18 46 0 (20 g per liter, 320 g in a 16 liter sprayer) or 1 percent urea (10 g per liter, 160 g in a 16 liter sprayer), twice a week apart.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea (46 0 0)** by Atlas Fertilizer, **Amigo Planters Ammonium Chloride** by La Filipina (25 0 0), **Agripower 46 0 0 (Locally Blended) Coated** by Green Acres Agri Tech and **Calcipro** by Ramgo (15.5 0 0 with 18.8 percent calcium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, mulch and add compost. Never skip the split doses. Let a soil test and the crop's color set the season's nitrogen.
Potassium deficiency in turmeric
Growth slows and internodes shorten. Leaf edges burn brown and dead spots form in the leaf, fewer side shoots grow, and plants wilt easily. You see it most at this stage: rhizome bulking.
Why potassium deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Sandy, leached soils and fields without potash.
How to tell it apart
Leaf blotch disease gives small spots over the leaf, not burned edges. To be sure, soil test for potassium.
What to apply for potassium deficiency
Give 90 kg potassium per hectare in four splits (at planting and 60, 90 and 120 days after), or a 1 percent potassium sulfate spray (10 g per liter, 160 g in a 16 liter sprayer) every 15 days.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash (MOP)** by Atlas Fertilizer (0 0 60), **Simplot Sulfate 0 0 50** by Nutranta, **Potassium Nitrate** by Parafield (13 0 46) and **Qrop Mix Production 14 0 23 plus 13 Cao** by Farmtech Agriland (14 0 23 with 9.3 percent calcium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, split potash through the season and add compost or ash. Test the soil every two or three years.
Phosphorus deficiency in turmeric
Growth slows and leaf color deepens, with browning or purple in some plants. Stems are thin, fewer side shoots form and the lower leaves are lost. You see it most at this stage: early growth.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Acid and volcanic soils that hold phosphorus.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency makes leaves paler, not darker. To be sure, soil test for available phosphorus.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency

Soak 6 kg superphosphate in 100 liters of water overnight, takes the clear liquid, adds 150 g urea, 150 g magnesium sulfate, 150 g ferrous sulfate and 100 g borax. Sprays it every 15 days until symptoms go. For the soil, apply phosphorus at planting following the soil test. A usual basal dose is 4 to 6 bags of Complete 14 14 14 per hectare in the furrow at planting. For quick help, spray Monoammonium phosphate or Monopotassium phosphate at 1 percent (160 grams in a 16 liter sprayer).

Sold here with phosphorus: **Philphos 18 46 0 (Di Ammonium Phosphate)**, **Atlas Super Gro (16 20 0)** by Atlas Fertilizer, **Amigo Planters Granular Single Super Phosphate** by La Filipina (0 18 0 with 11 percent sulfur) and **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals (0 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, apply phosphorus at planting each season.
Iron deficiency in turmeric
The yellowing begins between the veins of young leaves and soon covers the whole blade. A bad case leaves them fully white. You see it most at this stage: from the third month.
Why iron deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
High pH soils, waterlogging and low potassium.
How to tell it apart
Manganese deficiency gives a mottled light green look rather than full bleaching. To be sure, soil pH test and a leaf test. In a soil test, less than 4.5 ppm of iron is low.
What to apply for iron deficiency

Give 30 kg ferrous sulfate per hectare to the soil, followed by sprays of 2.5 kg ferrous sulfate per hectare in the third, fourth and fifth months. Spray Ferrous sulfate at 0.5 to 1 percent (80 to 160 grams in a 16 liter sprayer), or an iron chelate at the label rate, two or three times 7 to 10 days apart.

Sold here with iron: **DDDD Planter's Choice Ferrous Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Modern Time (19 percent iron), **Ferrous Sulfate Monohydrate** by Zetryl Chem (30 percent iron), **Ferrous Sulphate Monohydrate** by Newman Chemicals (30 percent iron) and **Liquid Chelate Iron with Sulfur** by Sagrex (5 percent iron and 3 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [iron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/iron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, plant on well drained beds and keep organic matter high. Test the soil every two or three years.
Magnesium deficiency in turmeric

Symptoms start on older leaves, which may drop or show a triangular arrowhead near the leaf stalk. Leaves yellow at the edges and between the veins until the whole leaf is yellow, and growth slows. You see it most at this stage: mid season.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Acid, sandy soils and heavy potash.
How to tell it apart
Potassium deficiency burns the leaf edges brown. To be sure, soil test for magnesium.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency

Give a 0.5 percent magnesium sulfate spray (5 g Epsom salt per liter) every 15 days until symptoms go. Give about 80 kg magnesium sulfate per hectare in bands near the plants. Apply it apart from potash.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **Agsmart Kieserite Granule** (20 percent sulfur and 16.3 percent magnesium), **DDDD Planter's Choice Magnesium Sulphate Monohydrate** by Modern Time (15.1 percent magnesium) and **Zetryl MAG 9** by Zetryl Chem (9 percent magnesium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, use dolomite on acid soils. Test the soil every two or three years. Lime acid soil with Dolomite rather than plain lime.
Zinc deficiency in turmeric
Leaves yellow between the veins and come out small and distorted, bunched in a rosette at the top. Plants branch less and roots are short. You see it most at this stage: early growth.
Why zinc deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
High pH soils and heavy phosphorus.
How to tell it apart
Iron deficiency bleaches young leaves without bunching. To be sure, soil test for zinc. In a soil test, less than 0.8 ppm of zinc is low.
What to apply for zinc deficiency

Give about 20 kg Zinc sulfate per hectare to the soil, or in severe cases a morning spray of 2 g zinc sulfate with 2.5 g lime per liter. Keep zinc and phosphate applications apart. Give the soil dose at planting or when the rains begin, and sprays on young growth.

Sold here with zinc: **Harvester Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Universal Harvester (22 percent zinc), **Petbowe Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate** (33 percent zinc), **Tierramino ZN** by Unilox Far East Resources (7 0 0 with 10 percent zinc) and **Liquid Chelate Zinc with Sulfur** by Sagrex (10 percent zinc and 5 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [fertilizer with zinc](/blog/micronutrients-for-rice), and the page on [zinc deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/zinc-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep the soil pH between 5 and 7.5. Test the soil every two or three years.
Sulfur deficiency in turmeric
Plants stay stunted and the leaves turn pale yellow, veins and all, until the whole leaf is chlorotic. Stems are thin and maturity is late. You see it most at this stage: early to mid growth.
Why sulfur deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Soils low in organic matter and burning crop waste.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency starts on the old leaves with red tinted edges. To be sure, soil and leaf test for sulfur. In a soil test, less than 10 ppm of sulfate sulfur is low.
What to apply for sulfur deficiency

Give a spray of 5 g magnesium sulfate with 10 g urea per liter every 15 days. Use a sulfur bearing fertilizer such as Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 or single superphosphate. Give about 25 kg sulfur dust per hectare on sulfur poor soils, or Gypsum on alkaline soils.

Sold here with sulfur: **Atlas Ammosul 21 0 0** by Atlas Fertilizer (21 0 0 with 24 percent sulfur), **Philphos Gypsum** (22.2 percent calcium and 17.4 percent sulfur), **Harvester Sulphate of Potash** by Universal Harvester (0 0 50 with 17.5 percent sulfur) and **Agsmart Kieserite Granule** (20 percent sulfur and 16.3 percent magnesium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [ammonium sulfate fertilizer](/blog/ammonium-sulfate-21-0-0), and the page on [sulfur deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/sulfur-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, add organic matter and stop burning trash. Test the soil every two or three years.
Manganese deficiency in turmeric
Symptoms show on new growth: leaves look mottled, light green to yellow green between the veins. Older leaves stay green. You see it most at this stage: early to mid growth.
Why manganese deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
High pH and over limed soils.
How to tell it apart
Iron deficiency bleaches young leaves more strongly. To be sure, leaf test for manganese. In a soil test, less than 1 ppm of manganese is low.
What to apply for manganese deficiency
Give a 0.5 percent manganese sulfate spray (5 g per liter, 80 g in a 16 liter sprayer), twice a week apart.

Sold here with manganese: **Manganese Sulfate** by Zetryl Chem (31 percent manganese), **Tierramino MN** by Unilox Far East Resources (7 0 0 with 12 percent manganese), **Multimate** by Agway (4 0 0 with 4.5 percent sulfur, 2.8 percent zinc and 1.8 percent manganese) and **Nutri Tabble Meta Foliar** by NS Northern Organic Fertilizer (12 percent zinc, 9 percent sulfur, 2 percent magnesium and 1.2 percent manganese). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [manganese deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/manganese-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, do not over lime. Test the soil every two or three years.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any turmeric nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your luyang dilaw needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Turmeric nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my luyang dilaw leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: older leaves pale yellow green with red tints creeping from the edges to the midrib. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at iron deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in turmeric?
items.a: Give 140 kg N per hectare as urea in five splits (at planting and 30, 60, 90 and 120 days after), with 60 kg P2O5 and 60 kg K2O. For quick help spray 2 percent DAP 18 46 0 (20 g per liter, 320 g in a 16 liter sprayer) or 1 percent urea (10 g per liter, 160 g in a 16 liter sprayer), twice a week apart.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in turmeric?
items.a: Give 90 kg potassium per hectare in four splits (at planting and 60, 90 and 120 days after), or a 1 percent potassium sulfate spray (10 g per liter, 160 g in a 16 liter sprayer) every 15 days.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes phosphorus deficiency in turmeric?
items.a: Soak 6 kg superphosphate in 100 liters of water overnight, takes the clear liquid, adds 150 g urea, 150 g magnesium sulfate, 150 g ferrous sulfate and 100 g borax. Sprays it every 15 days until symptoms go.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my luyang dilaw lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the turmeric nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
